title: Solid Concrete
description: Ever wanted concrete to be one solid color? Well, here you go! In addition, this pack also makes concrete glow using Optifine.
body:
Solid Concrete improves the look of concrete blocks while staying close to the vanilla style.

The textures are smoother and more consistent, making concrete better for large builds, walls, and modern structures.

Features
• Improved concrete textures
• Keeps the vanilla Minecraft style
• Works alongside other resource packs
• 16× resolution for perfect vanilla compatibility
• Optional emissive glow effect with OptiFine

Requirements
The glow effect requires OptiFine emissive textures.
Without OptiFine, the textures will still work normally but will not glow.
